character.motivation: Cut the lease page to buy the tenants time. Wants to correct the record without letting the council make her the whole story.
character.voice: Names dates and physical details. Gets blunt when a record was altered.
character.backstory: Tess cut the tenantsâ€™ page out of the lease ledger to buy the families time to move. The missing page let the council treat the land as vacant during the sale, a consequence she has avoided explaining for years.
character.quest_hook: Help Tess put the records in order for public or private access after the hearing, including an account of why she removed the page.

dialogue.introduction: The flood ledger is missing page twelve. The binding has been cut. Water doesn't do that.
dialogue.friendship: I used to mend the books where nobody could see the stitches. I leave them visible now.
dialogue.supper: I wrote down who brought what. It felt good to keep a record nobody wanted me to change.
dialogue.hearing: I will keep every version of the ledger, including the one with my cut in it.
dialogue.witness: Page twelve listed the floodplain leases. I cut it out myself. People were already packing, and I thought the missing page would buy them time. It bought the council time instead.
dialogue.after_testimony: I've left a blank space on the archive shelf. The ledger deserves to come back with all its pages.
dialogue.favorite_gift: I'll press it with the market notices. That's a better date stamp than ink.
dialogue.disliked_gift: The grass will shed in the bindings. Please keep it out of the archive.

routine.hobby: Reads in the shade at the commons
routine.home_context: Lives close enough to Iona to return ordinary records on foot, with the lease papers kept at home.

story_stop.activity: Checks lease dates against the families’ accounts
